cmd.view.style_shaded_plain.desc: 3D visual style: lit faces without edges. Reads calmly on dense models.
cmd.view.style_realistic.desc: 3D visual style: surfaces by category, sky reflection, shadows and occlusion as the performance level allows.
cmd.view.gfx_auto.desc: Chooses the level from this graphics adapter and a short measurement.
cmd.view.gfx_speed.desc: No shadows, occlusion or antialiasing. For weak graphics and very large models.
cmd.view.gfx_balanced.desc: Antialiasing, light shadows and occlusion. Target: 50 frames per second.
cmd.view.gfx_quality.desc: Sharp shadows and full-resolution occlusion. Target: 30 frames per second.
v3d.style.tip.wireframe: Wireframe: edges only, you see through everything
v3d.style.tip.hidden_line: Hidden line: edges, with what is behind faces hidden
v3d.style.tip.shaded: Shaded with edges: lit faces with their edges
v3d.style.tip.realistic: Realistic: surfaces by category, reflections, shadows and occlusion
v3d.style.tip.consistent: Consistent colours: category colours without shadows, the same from any side
v3d.style.tip.xray: X-ray: everything is see-through, edges stay visible
v3d.gfx.unavailable: This graphics adapter cannot draw the 3D view. The model is safe. Click the note in the status line.
settings.gfx_level_desc: Applies to this computer, never saved in a project. Plans and sections stay sharp at every level.
settings.gfx.auto.desc: Chosen from this graphics adapter and a short measurement.
settings.gfx.speed.desc: Without shadows, occlusion and antialiasing. Target: 60 frames per second.
settings.gfx.balanced.desc: Antialiasing, light shadows and occlusion. Target: 50 frames per second.
settings.gfx.quality.desc: Sharp shadows and full-resolution occlusion. Target: 30 frames per second.
gfx.note.safe: Safe graphics: the last start failed in the driver
gfx.note.safe.tip: Click to try the normal graphics at the next start.
gfx.note.unusable: 3D is unavailable on this graphics adapter
gfx.note.unusable.tip: Click for a safer graphics start next time. Plans and sections keep working.
gfx.note.realistic: Realistic style is unavailable: showing shaded
gfx.note.realistic.tip: This graphics adapter rejected the style. Click to open the performance settings.
gfx.note.memory: Not enough graphics memory: quality lowered
gfx.note.memory.tip: Antialiasing, shadows or occlusion were turned off until restart. Click to open the performance settings.
gfx.note.effects: Shadows or occlusion are unavailable on this adapter
gfx.note.effects.tip: Click to open the performance settings.
gfx.note.lowered.tip: Quality returns as soon as the view stops. Click to choose a level.
gfx.note.low_tier: Auto chose maximum speed for this adapter
gfx.fatal.title: DDC Editor cannot start its graphics
gfx.fatal.choose_safe: Yes — start with safe graphics.  No — open the log.  Cancel — close.
gfx.fatal.choose_log: Yes — open the log.  No — close.
gfx.lost.title: Graphics stopped working
gfx.lost.restarted: Graphics was reset: unsaved work is kept, the app restarted with safer graphics
gfx.lost.unsaved_title: Graphics stopped working: work not saved
gfx.lost.unsaved_body:
The graphics device was lost ({reason}), and the autosave snapshot could not be written: {why}.

Your unsaved work is NOT saved yet, so DDC Editor did not restart.
Working copy: {copy}

Yes — try saving again.  No — save as…  Cancel — close without saving (the next start tries to recover the working copy).
gfx.chip.soft: Running without the graphics card — Try graphics card
gfx.chip.soft.tip:
The picture is drawn by the processor: slow, and it keeps the processor busy. Why: {why}.
Click to use the graphics card from the next start. If it fails twice in a row at start, the app goes back by itself.
gfx.chip.next: Graphics card from the next start
gfx.chip.next.tip: Restart the app to use the graphics card.
gfx.chip.why_unknown: no graphics card answered at start
gfx.why.asked: a safer start was asked for
gfx.why.lost: the graphics card stopped responding while working
gfx.why.early: the app closed at start twice in a row
gfx.why.flag: the safe graphics option was given at start
